PRACTICE AREAS

Family law

Uncontested and contested divorce, custody, contact and child maintenance.

Family matters are among the most personal you will ever deal with. We help you make decisions with a clear head, aim for an agreement first and go to court only when it is truly necessary.

What we handle

  • Uncontested divorce before a notary
  • Contested divorce
  • Custody and contact with children
  • Spousal and child maintenance
  • Property disputes between spouses and civil partners

What to bring to the first meeting

  • Marriage certificate or civil partnership agreement
  • Family status certificate
  • Tax statements and income details, if maintenance is an issue
  • Any existing correspondence or agreement

Frequently asked questions

Do we need to go to court for an uncontested divorce?

No. Since 2018 an uncontested divorce is done by notarial deed. Each spouse has their own lawyer and, if there are minor children, you agree in writing on custody and contact.

Can I ask for maintenance before the divorce is final?

Yes. Through interim measures the court can set temporary maintenance until the main case is decided. We'll look together at whether this suits your situation.
